chrome.help: Hover an element to see what it does

children.name: ToolsTab
children.help: Text editors (in-game and browser) and text detection settings

children.name: TextEditorHint
children.text: Click on any text in-game to edit its translation or retranslate it with AI.

children.name: TextEditorBtn
children.help: Pick any text on screen to fix its translation without leaving the game

children.name: BrowserEditorHint
children.text: Edit your translation file comfortably in your browser while playing — no account needed, nothing is published. Each save is applied in-game automatically.

children.name: BrowserEditorBtn
children.help: Open your translation in a browser editor: search, filters, and every save applied in-game live

children.name: DetectionHint
children.text: Control how the mod detects special text patterns. Disable if causing issues with your game.

children.name: TypewritingToggle
children.help: Detects text that appears letter by letter, like dialogues, and waits for it to settle before translating. Disable if it causes issues.

children.name: TypewritingHint
children.text: Text that appears letter by letter (dialogues, cutscenes). Waits for the text to stabilize before translating.

children.name: ConcatToggle
children.help: Detects text assembled in parts, like tooltips or item stats, and translates each part for better cache reuse. Disable if it causes issues.

children.name: ConcatHint
children.text: Text built in multiple steps (tooltips, item stats). Translates each part separately for better cache reuse.

children.name: ExclusionsTab
children.help: Prevent specific texts or UI elements from being translated

children.name: ExclusionsHint
children.text: Exclude UI elements from translation (chat windows, player names, etc.). Exclusions are shared when you upload your translation.

children.name: InspectorBtn
children.help: Closes this panel so you can click UI elements in-game to exclude them from translation.

children.name: ExclInspectorHint
children.text: Click on UI elements to exclude them

children.name: PatternInput
children.help: Type a hierarchy path pattern to exclude. Use ** for any depth and * for a single level.

children.name: ExclAddBtn
children.help: Adds the typed pattern to the exclusion list. Takes effect on Apply.

children.name: ExclPatternHint
children.text: Use ** for any depth, * for single level

children.name: FindValueInput
children.help: Type text visible in-game to locate the UI element that shows it, then exclude it.

children.name: ExclFindBtn
children.help: Searches the scene for UI components displaying the entered text.

children.name: ExclFindHint
children.text: Find which UI component displays this text, then exclude it

children.name: FindResultsScroll
children.empty: No UI component found with this text.

children.name: FontsTab
children.help: Replace the game's fonts when they can't display your language's characters

children.name: ImagesTab
children.help: Replace images that contain baked-in text

children.name: ImagesHint
children.text: Replace images that contain text (bitmap text) with translated versions. Use the inspector to select images, export originals as templates, then import your translated PNG files.

children.name: EnableImageReplacementToggle
children.text: Enable image replacement (uncheck to debug with original images)
children.help: Swaps images that contain baked-in text for your translated versions. Uncheck to debug with the original images.

children.name: ImageInspectorBtn
children.help: Closes this panel so you can click images in-game to mark them for replacement.

children.name: ImageInspectorHint
children.text: Click on images in the game to mark them for replacement

children.name: ImagesScroll
children.empty:
No images marked for replacement yet.
Use the Image Inspector to select images.

children.name: ApplyAllBtn
children.help: Reloads your edited PNG files from disk and applies them in-game. Use after editing the exported templates.

children.name: VariablesTab
children.help: Protect dynamic values (numbers, names) inside translated texts

children.name: VarsHint
children.text: Capture dynamic game values (player name, clan name, etc.) so translations can be reused regardless of the actual value. Variables are replaced with placeholders before translation.

children.name: CaptureHint
children.text: Enter the current value of a game variable (e.g. your character name) to find it in memory.

children.name: ScanValueInput
children.help: Type the current value of a game variable, like your character name, to find it in memory.

children.name: ScanBtn
children.help: Searches game memory for the entered value so it can be turned into a reusable placeholder.

children.name: ScanResultsScroll
children.empty: No matching fields found in game memory.

children.name: FontsGlobalTab
children.help: Global font settings for every detected font, including fallbacks and sharpness.

children.name: FontsHint
children.text: Configure translation for detected fonts. Add fallback fonts for non-Latin scripts (Hindi, Arabic, Chinese, etc.). Settings are saved with translations.

children.name: EnableFontReplacementToggle
children.text: Enable font replacement (uncheck to debug with original fonts)
children.help: Replaces game fonts so your language's characters display correctly. Uncheck to debug with the original fonts.

children.name: FontSharpness
children.help: How finely replacement fonts are rendered. Higher = crisper when the translation scales text up, but uses more video memory. 'Auto' is a safe default. Text size is unchanged. Takes effect on the next font rebuild.

children.name: RefreshFontsBtn
children.help: Rescans the game for fonts currently in use and updates the list below.

children.name: FontsScroll
children.empty: No fonts detected yet. Play the game to detect fonts.

children.name: FontsOverridesTab
children.help: Per-element rules that override the font size for specific UI elements.

children.name: OverridesHint
children.text: Override font size for specific UI elements. Use inspector, search, or manual pattern.

children.name: FontOverrideInspectorBtn
children.help: Closes this panel so you can click a UI element in-game to create a font override for it.

children.name: OverrideInspectorHint
children.text: Click on a UI element to create an override for it

children.name: FindOverrideInput
children.help: Type text visible in-game to locate the UI element that shows it, then create an override.

children.name: FindOverrideBtn
children.help: Searches the scene for UI components displaying the entered text.

children.name: OverrideFindResults
children.empty: No UI component found with this text.

children.name: ManualOverrideInput
children.help: Type a rule to match elements. Prefix with path:, font:, or text: to match by hierarchy, font name, or content.

children.name: AddOverrideBtn
children.help: Adds the typed pattern as a new override rule. Takes effect on Apply.
